n7f48287822.headline: Wall Street's top cop is determined to bring crypto to heel. He just took a big shot
n7f48287822.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission announced a series of lawsuits this week against crypto exchanges Coinbase and Binance. The outcome could help define the future of the cryptocurrency sector.
n7f48287822.why: Coinbase is a major US-listed crypto exchange and Binance is one of the largest global crypto trading platforms, so enforcement actions against them shape regulatory expectations for the whole sector.

impacts.name: Coinbase
impacts.why: The SEC lawsuit targets Coinbase, creating legal and regulatory risk for the exchange.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7f48287822.why_moved: The SEC's lawsuits against two major crypto exchanges raise regulatory risk for the sector, and the source says the outcome could help define its future.

n20099c1002.headline: Electricity Price Falls 17% This Sunday, to 67.2 Euros/MWh
n20099c1002.summary: The average electricity price for regulated tariff customers in Spain fell 16.91% on Sunday to 67.2 euros per megawatt hour compared to the previous day.
n20099c1002.why: Electricity prices impact industrial costs and consumer bills, influencing inflation and economic activity in Spain and the broader Eurozone energy market.
n20099c1002.why_moved: The sharp drop in electricity prices reduces costs for consumers and businesses, affecting inflation and energy market dynamics.
